messages.subject: Change in facet_wrap
parts:
Hi,

I just updated from version 0.9.1 to version 0.9.3. 

I have data for 3 chemicals collected at 5 locations.

I have  older code that worked on 0.9.1 which would generate separate boxplots for each chemical. These chemicals are generally log normally distributed.

> p <- ggplot(data = BGextra, aes(x = label , y = result ) )
> p + geom_boxplot()  + facet_wrap(~component, ncol = 1, scale = "free_y") + coord_trans(y = "log")

now produces the error
"Error in facet_render.wrap(plot$facet, panel, plot$coordinates, plot_theme(plot),  :
  ggplot2 does not currently support free scales with a non-cartesian coord or coord_flip."

I read in the Change log how this error message was added in 0.9.3.  Does anyone know why this worked before and what might be a work-around?

Here is a simple example of my problem using the iris data

data(iris)

irisTall <- melt(iris, id.vars="Species")

p <- ggplot(data = irisTall, aes(x = Species, y = value) )
p + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(~variable, scale = "free_y") + coord_trans(ytrans="log")



Thanks,

Matt
